Title: Speech at the Conference on Capital Markets
text: SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE Dr. Ernesto Gouveia Gove Capital Markets Conference Maputo, 10 July 2014 Senhor Vice--Mini i stro d a s Fina n c as, Exce lencia Mr President of the Tax Authority of Mozambique, Excellency Madam President, Directors and Members of the Supervisory Board of the Mozambique Stock Exchange Mr. Administrators of the Bank of Mozambique Mr Chairman of the Board of Directors of Euronext Lisbon, Portugal Mr . ViceChairman of the Board of Directors of Galp Energia, Portugal Presidents of the Boards of Directors and Executive Committees of financial institutions Representatives of economic associations and cooperation partners Dignissimos Guests Ladies and gentlemen Allow me to begin my speech by welcoming and welcoming all those invited to this Capital Markets Conference, including representatives of institutions financial , business and academic sector in Mozambique, including our cooperation partners. A special greeting and a word of appreciation are due to the participation in this Conference of the delegations of Euronext Lisbon (Lisbon Stock Exchange) and GALP Energia, Portugal, to whom I wish a good stay among us and enjoy the richness of our culture, gastronomy and traditional hospitality. The existence of a broad and efficient capital market in Mozambique is now an important condition not only for the country's economic growth, but also for the sustainable development of 2 social and financial inclusion of the population and for greater participation of national entities in ongoing projects and undertakings at national level. For this reason, I would like to commend the initiative of the Mozambique Stock Exchange to provide this space for reflection and exchange of experiences. It is our hope that this event will also allow for greater promotion and dissemination of our capital market at national and international level. Ladies and gentlemen This meeting takes place at a time when the global economic and financial crisis cannot yet be regarded as over, as a considerable number of institutions still remain in a turbulence or inactivity, despite the gradual return of the main financial markets to normality . However , the Mozambican economy has been particularly resilient to the external shocks arising from the crisis, witnessing today a profound restructuring in the various sectors, mainly driven by large investments in research and exploitation of resources with particular relevance to coal and gas. The current economic environment opens up new opportunities for the business sector, where the financial sector, and in particular the capital market, will play a particularly important role in meeting the immense needs of funding, by the dynamics in the transmission of shareholdings. We have always assumed that countries like ours should see in the crisis an opportunity to catapult growth with macroeconomic stability, exploiting new markets, strengthening international cooperation, including South-South cooperation, and diversifying the productive base through the common and sustainable use of the enormous natural resources of which and extending business opportunities to new sectors and branches of activity. In view of the moment, the scheduled themes and the expected impact, I consider this conference to be timely and of paramount importance for our country by promoting greater reflection, dissemination and awareness of the capital market, broad , strong and efficient. Ladies and gentlemen In addition to the existence of a stable financial system, it is also essential for the development of the economy that financial entities, in particular banks, insurers and other entities, promote the diversification of products and services and the expansion of financial branches and services throughout the national territory, especially in the most disadvantaged regions, thus contributing to financial inclusion, a key requirement for the dissemination of the capital for the entire population and to all economic actors. We are pleased to see increasing investment, translated into the modernisation of credit institutions and the entry of new economic operators at national level. In the area of financing the economy, we should not only look at large projects but also small, micro and medium-sized enterprises, which deserve the full support of financial institutions. They are strongly recognized as the important role they play in the development of the economy as a source of wealth creation, job creation and household income. We have the challenge of improving their access to finance, either through banking or through the various financing alternatives available in the capital and stock exchange. I am sure that the solutions to the current constraints should also include information on the part of the market, as well as business training, which allow micro, small and medium-sized enterprises to take advantage of the opportunities generated by the country's economic growth. In the current context of our growth, the role of the capital market, and in particular the Stock Exchange, becomes particularly relevant as a result of recent discoveries and the start of exploitation of natural resources, there is therefore an increasing need for the promotion and development of an efficient capital market, which ensures a greater dispersion of capital and contributes to greater economic inclusion. It should be said that the Government has approved the Strategy for the Development of the Financial Sector 2013-2022 with a view, among other objectives, to increase the supply of capital and services and products affordable financial resources, strengthening of the capital market , in particular in the area of internal finance. Following the strategy of its economic program, the Government approved in 2013 the Decree establishing the legal regime of Treasury Bonds, also creating the status of Specialist Operators in Treasury Bonds and establishing the mechanisms that ensure the passage securities to the general public through their exchange market transaction. It should be noted that since 2013 the Government has published the calendar of public debt issues, information that enables financial intermediaries to prepare their public debt applications, and the general public to diversify their sources of savings. Another strategic decision of the Government was the creation of the Securities And Exchange Center in Mozambique, whose main scope is the centralized registration of all securities issued and/or traded in Mozambique, ensuring greater control and knowledge of movements occurred on the securities. Ladies and gentlemen In Mozambique, the financing obtained through the Capital Market via the Stock Exchange reached in the last 15 years the total value of 33,812 million MT (corresponding to 1,100 million USD), on the one hand, through public and business debt. On the other hand, both the State and the Companies used the Capital Market, through the Stock Exchange, to finance themselves through the sale or subscription, intended to the general public, of shareholdings of companies (shares), the most recent being the sale of 10% of the share capital of EMOSE  Mozambican Insurance Company, in 2013. The success achieved with these stock exchange operations indicates to us that we are on the right track; the divestitures of shareholdings under the Public-Private Partnerships Act, Large Projects and Business Concessions, carried out through the Mozambique Stock Exchange, contribute to the government's objective of empowering mozambique, thus ensuring greater economic inclusion. Although the capital market in Mozambique still faces some difficulties inherent in any growing market, the Mozambique Stock Exchange has performed well over the years, patenting in developments in recent years (2011 to 2013), a period in which the number of securities listed increased from 25 to 34; the volume of transactions increased by 413%, reaching 2.025 million MT in 2013 (66 Million MT). million USD); and the number of securities traded in BVM increased by 399%. We are pleased to note a significant growth in stock market capitalization, the main indicator of stock exchanges, which went from 16,998 million MT (553 million USD) in 2011 to 35,946 million MT (1,169 million USD) in 2013, representing growth of 111%, equivalent to 8% of GDP. Distinguished guests Ladies and gentlemen At regional level, Mozambique is strongly engaged in the process of economic integration of the SADC countries, and at the level of the capital market, the Scholarship Committee has been institutionalized ( CoSSE), that the Mozambique Stock Exchange was one of the founding members, and was recently given responsibility for the training of visibility and dissemination of information from regional Stock Exchanges. The commitment of the Stock Exchanges of the SADC countries to achieve the objectives defined by this organization, as well as the adoption of its Strategic Plan 2012-2016, aim to the creation of conditions that ensure the efficient and productive allocation of capital in the region. I must also say that the achievement of one of the main challenges of CoSSE, that is , the interconnection between the Stock Exchanges, will contribute to greater visibility of the region, for easier access for investors to the market, for cost reduction by the effect of economies of scale, in a process that will surely benefit all exchanges and all capital markets in the region, contributing to the establishment of an economically strong block at SADC level. This regional cooperation strategy has been replicated by the Stock Exchange to other geographies and other markets, with the aim of exchanging experience and capacity building, and contacts have been established with multilateral bodies, including the Association of African Stock Exchanges (ASEA) and the World Congress of Scholarships (WEC), and bilateral, and have been formalized in cooperation protocols with the Portuguese Stock Exchange, Euronext Lisbon, represented here at the highest level, and more recently with the Warsaw Stock Exchange (Poland). Ladies and gentlemen I could not finish my speech without mentioning a matter which I consider to be of fundamental importance and which contributes to the elevation of the socio-economic level of the population and to the macroeconomic and financial stability of a country: a financial education, one of the pillars of the financial inclusion strategy. In fact, a well-informed and adequately trained population contributes to greater savings and their application in financial products and services that meet the needs and risk profile of investors. In this context, I congratulate the Mozambique Stock Exchange for the preparation and approval of a Financial Education Program in Capital Markets and Dissemination of the Stock Exchange, which includes the holding of this conference, also alusive to the celebration of its 15 years of activity. I am fully aware that the theme of the Capital Market will not be exhausted at this Conference. However, I am convinced that it will contribute to a greater awareness and driving of the Capital Market and the Stock Exchange. With these words, I finish by declaring this conference open and making good wishes for good work , with rich debates and ideas that will certainly enrich the presentations that will be brought here. Thank you very much!
text_original: DISCURSO DE SUA EXCELNCIA O GOVERNADOR DO BANCO DE MOAMBIQUE Dr. Ernesto Gouveia Gove Conferncia sobre Mercado de Capitais Maputo, 10 de Julho de 2014 Senhor Vice-Ministro das Finanas, Excelncia Senhor Presidente da Autoridade Tributria de Moambique, Excelncia Senhora Presidente, Senhores Administradores e Membros do Conselho Fiscal da Bolsa de Valores de Moambique Senhores Administradores do Banco de Moambique Senhor Presidente do Conselho de Administrao da Euronext Lisbon, Portugal Senhor Vice-Presidente do Conselho de Administrao da Galp Energia, Portugal Senhores Presidentes de Conselhos de Administrao e de Comisses Executivas de instituies financeiras Senhores Representantes de associaes econmicas e de parceiros de cooperao Dignssimos Convidados Minhas senhoras e Meus senhores Permitam-me que inicie a minha interveno saudando e formulando votos de boas-vindas a todos os convidados a esta Conferncia sobre Mercado de Capitais, designadamente representantes de instituies pblicas e privadas do sector financeiro, empresarial e acadmico em Moambique, incluindo os nossos parceiros de cooperao. Uma saudao especial e uma palavra de apreo so devidas  participao nesta Conferncia das delegaes da Euronext Lisbon (Bolsa de Lisboa) e da GALP Energia, Portugal, a quem desejo uma boa estadia entre ns e que desfrutem da riqueza da nossa cultura, gastronomia e tradicional hospitalidade. A existncia de um mercado de capitais amplo e eficiente em Moambique constitui, hoje, condio importante no apenas para o crescimento econmico do Pas, como tambm para o desenvolvimento sustentvel da 2 economia, para a incluso social e financeira da populao e para uma maior participao de entidades nacionais nos projectos e empreendimentos em curso  escala nacional. Por essa razo, gostaria de louvar a iniciativa da Bolsa de Valores de Moambique de proporcionar este espao de reflexo e de troca de experincias.  nossa esperana que este evento tambm permita uma maior promoo e divulgao do nosso mercado de capitais  escala nacional e internacional. Minhas senhoras e Meus senhores Este encontro tem lugar numa altura em que a crise econmica e financeira global no se pode considerar ainda como terminada, pois persiste um nmero considervel de instituies que em todo o mundo continuam ainda numa situao de turbulncia ou inactividade, apesar do retorno gradual dos principais mercados financeiros  normalidade. Entretanto, a economia moambicana tem-se mostrado particularmente resiliente aos choques externos decorrentes da crise, assistindo-se hoje a uma profunda reestruturao nos diversos sectores, impulsionada principalmente pelos grandes investimentos na pesquisa e explorao de recursos naturais, com especial relevncia para o carvo mineral e o gs. A actual conjuntura econmica abre novas oportunidades ao sector empresarial, onde o sector financeiro, e em particular o mercado de capitais, ter um papel de especial relevo na satisfao das imensas necessidades de financiamento, pela dinmica na transmisso de participaes sociais. Sempre assumimos que pases como o nosso devem ver na crise uma oportunidade para catapultar o crescimento com estabilidade macroeconmica, explorando novos mercados, reforando a cooperao internacional, incluindo a cooperao sul-sul, e diversificando a base produtiva, atravs do uso regrado e sustentvel dos enormes recursos naturais de que dispomos e do alargamento das oportunidades de negcios a novos sectores e ramos de actividade. Face ao momento, aos temas agendados e ao impacto esperado, considero esta conferncia de oportuna e de primordial importncia para o nosso pas ao promover uma maior reflexo, divulgao e sensibilizao sobre o mercado de capitais, que se pretende amplo, forte e eficiente. Minhas senhoras e Meus senhores Para alm da existncia de um sistema financeiro estvel,  ainda essencial para o desenvolvimento da economia que as entidades financeiras, em particular os bancos, as seguradoras e demais entidades, promovam a diversificao de produtos e servios e a expanso de balces e servios financeiros em todo o territrio nacional, em especial nas regies mais desfavorecidas, assim contribuindo para a incluso financeira, requisito fundamental para a disseminao do mercado de capitais a toda a populao e a todos os agentes econmicos. Assistimos com satisfao a uma crescente realizao de investimentos, traduzidos na modernizao das instituies de crdito e na entrada de novos operadores econmicos  escala nacional. No domnio do financiamento  economia, no devemos olhar apenas para os grandes projectos mas tambm para as pequenas, micro e mdias empresas, que merecem todo o apoio das instituies financeiras. A elas vivamente se reconhece o importante papel que tm no desenvolvimento da economia, enquanto fonte de criao de riqueza, de gerao de emprego e de rendimento das famlias. Temos o ingente desafio de melhorar o acesso ao financiamento por parte destas, quer atravs da banca, quer atravs das diversas alternativas de financiamento disponveis no mercado de capitais e bolsa de valores. Estou certo de que as solues aos actuais constrangimentos devem tambm incluir informao por parte do mercado, bem assim capacitao empresarial, que permitam s micro, pequenas e mdias empresas usufruir das oportunidades geradas pelo crescimento econmico do Pas. No actual contexto do nosso crescimento, o papel do mercado de capitais, e em particular da Bolsa de Valores, torna-se particularmente relevante em resultado das recentes descobertas e incio de explorao de recursos naturais, havendo, por isso, uma cada vez maior necessidade de promoo e desenvolvimento de um mercado de capitais eficiente, que assegure uma maior disperso do capital e concorra para uma maior incluso econmica. Refira-se que o Governo aprovou a Estratgia para o Desenvolvimento do Sector Financeiro 2013-2022 visando, entre outros objectivos, o aumento da oferta de capital e dos servios e produtos financeiros a preos acessveis, assim como o fortalecimento do mercado de capitais, nomeadamente na vertente do financiamento interno. No seguimento da estratgia do seu programa econmico, o Governo aprovou em 2013 o Decreto que estabelece o regime jurdico das Obrigaes do Tesouro, criando tambm o estatuto de Operadores Especializados em Obrigaes do Tesouro e estabelecendo os mecanismos que asseguram a passagem dos ttulos para o pblico em geral, atravs da sua transaco em mercado de bolsa. Note-se que desde 2013 o Governo publica o calendrio de emisses de Dvida Pblica, informao que possibilita aos intermedirios financeiros a preparao das suas aplicaes em Dvida Pblica, e ao pblico em geral a possibilidade de diversificarem as suas fontes de aplicao das poupanas. Outra deciso estratgica do Governo foi a criao da Central de Valores Mobilirios em Moambique, cujo escopo principal  o registo centralizado de todos os valores mobilirios emitidos e/ou negociados em Moambique, assegurando um maior controlo e conhecimento das movimentaes ocorridas sobre os ttulos. Minhas senhoras e Meus senhores Em Moambique, o financiamento obtido atravs do Mercado de Capitais via Bolsa de Valores atingiu nos ltimos 15 anos o valor total de 33.812 milhes MT (o correspondente a 1.100 milhes USD), por um lado, atravs de emisses de dvida pblica e de empresas. Por outro lado, quer o Estado, quer as Empresas, utilizaram o Mercado de Capitais, atravs da Bolsa de Valores, para se financiarem atravs da venda ou subscrio, destinadas ao pblico em geral, de participaes sociais de sociedades (aces), sendo a mais recente a alienao de 10% do capital social da EMOSE  Empresa Moambicana de Seguros, em 2013. O sucesso obtido com estas operaes de bolsa indica-nos que estamos no bom caminho; as alienaes de participaes sociais ao abrigo da Lei das Parcerias Pblico-Privadas, Projectos de Grande Dimenso e Concesses Empresariais, realizadas atravs da Bolsa de Valores de Moambique, concorrem para o objectivo do Governo de empoderamento dos moambicanos, garantindo assim uma maior incluso econmica. Apesar de o mercado de capitais em Moambique enfrentar ainda algumas dificuldades inerentes a qualquer mercado em crescimento, a Bolsa de Valores de Moambique tem apresentado um bom desempenho ao longo dos anos, patentes na evoluo dos ltimos anos (2011 a 2013), perodo em que o nmero de ttulos cotados aumentou de 25 para 34; o volume de transaces aumentou 413%, tendo atingido em 2013 o montante de 2.025 milhes MT (66 milhes USD); e o nmero de ttulos transaccionados na BVM aumentou 399%.  com satisfao que notamos um crescimento expressivo da capitalizao bolsista, o principal indicador das bolsas de valores, que passou de 16.998 milhes MT (553 milhes USD) em 2011 para 35.946 milhes MT (1.169 milhes USD) em 2013, representando um crescimento de 111%, equivalente a 8% do PIB. Distintos convidados Minhas senhoras e Meus senhores Ao nvel regional, Moambique est fortemente engajado no processo de integrao econmica dos pases da SADC, sendo que, ao nvel do mercado de capitais, foi institucionalizado o Comit das Bolsas da SADC (CoSSE), de que a Bolsa de Valores de Moambique foi um dos membros fundadores, tendo-lhe sido recentemente atribuda a responsabilidade pela capacitao institucional, visibilidade e disseminao da informao das Bolsas de Valores regionais. O comprometimento das Bolsas de Valores dos pases da SADC no alcance dos objectivos definidos por esta organizao, bem como a adopo do seu Plano Estratgico 2012-2016, tm em vista a criao de condies que assegurem a alocao eficiente e produtiva do capital na regio. Cumpre-me dizer ainda que o alcance de um dos principais desafios do CoSSE, ou seja, a interligao entre as Bolsas de Valores, vai contribuir para uma maior visibilidade da regio, para um acesso mais fcil dos investidores ao mercado, para uma reduo de custos por efeito de economias de escala, num processo que vai seguramente beneficiar todas as Bolsas e todos os mercados de capitais da regio, contribuindo para o estabelecimento de um bloco economicamente forte ao nvel da SADC. Esta estratgia de cooperao regional tem sido replicada pela Bolsa de Valores para outras geografias e outros mercados, com o objectivo de troca de experincias e capacitao, tendo sido estabelecidos contactos com organismos multilaterais, nomeadamente a Associao das Bolsas de Valores Africanas (ASEA) e o Congresso Mundial das Bolsas (WEC), e bilaterais, tendo sido formalizados, nesse mbito, protocolos de Cooperao com a Bolsa portuguesa, a Euronext Lisbon, aqui representada ao mais alto nvel, e mais recentemente com a Bolsa de Valores de Varsvia (Polnia). Minhas senhoras e Meus senhores No podia terminar a minha interveno sem referir uma matria que considero de fundamental importncia e que contribui para a elevao do nvel socioeconmico da populao e para a estabilidade macroeconmica e financeira de um Pas: a educao financeira, um dos pilares da estratgia de incluso financeira. Na verdade, uma populao bem informada e com adequado nvel de formao concorre para uma maior captao de poupanas e para a sua aplicao em produtos e servios financeiros que respondam s necessidades e perfil de risco dos investidores. Neste mbito, congratulo a Bolsa de Valores de Moambique pela elaborao e aprovao de um Programa de Educao Financeira em Mercado de Capitais e Divulgao da Bolsa de Valores, no qual se enquadra a realizao desta conferncia, alusiva tambm  celebrao dos seus 15 anos de actividade. Estou plenamente consciente de que a temtica do Mercado de Capitais no se vai esgotar nesta Conferncia. Contudo, estou convicto de que ir concorrer para uma maior sensibilizao e dinamizao do Mercado de Capitais e da Bolsa de Valores. Com estas palavras, termino, declarando aberta a presente conferncia e fazendo votos de bom trabalho, com ricos debates e ideias que por certo enriquecero as apresentaes que aqui sero trazidas. Muito Obrigado!

Title: Financial Education Program Launch
text: SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE ON THE OCCASION OF THE LAUNCH OF THE FINANCIAL EDUCATION PROGRAMME OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE MAPUTO 22 OCTOBER 2014 SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE ON THE OCCASION OF THE LAUNCH OF THE FINANCIAL EDUCATION PROGRAMME OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE MAPUTO 22 OCTOBER 2014 1 Governor's Speech 1 Governor's Speech Mr Deputy Minister for State Administration , Excellency , Gentlemen Members of the Diplomatic Corps, Excellencies, Mr . Deputy Governor of the Bank of Mozambique , Excellency , Mr. Administrators of the Bank of Mozambique, Mr. Adriano Maleiane, Former Governor of the Bank of Mozambique, Presidents of the Boards of Directors and Executive Committees of financial institutions, Mr President of the CTA, Former Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Gentlemen National Directors, Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Representatives of cooperation partner institutions, Ladies and gentlemen of the Coordination Committee of the National Payment System, Representatives of media, Mr President of the National Union of Bank Employees, Mr President of the Workers' Association of the Bank of Mozambique, Mr Representative of the Company Committee of the National Union of Bank Employees at the Bank of Mozambique, Distinguished guests, Ladies, Gentlemen , It is with great emotion that on behalf of the Board of Directors and on my own behalf I welcome v's presence. I am so honored and distinguished at this ceremony to launch the Financial Education Program of the Bank of Mozambique. In particular, I would like to thank the presence of His Excellencies the Minister of Education and Deputy Minister of State Administration, who once again come to witness the commitment of power with the cause of financial education in our country. I express my special thanks to the distinguished representatives of credit institutions and financial corporations, to our cooperation partners and to the media, who are important counterparties of the Bank of Mozambique in fulfilling its multiple tasks. Ladies, gentlemen, In April 2013, the Government of the Republic of Mozambique approved the Financial Sector Development Strategy 2013-2022, with a view to developing a sound , diversified, competitive and inclusive financial sector that offers the public and businesses, particularly micro and small enterprises, have access to a wide range of adequate and high-quality financial services. Under this Strategy, the Bank of Mozambique was responsible for coordinating the preparation of the National Strategy for Financial Inclusion. In this context, this year the terms of reference and the action plan containing the principles that will serve as the basis for the preparation of the National Strategy Financial Inclusion, the materialisation of which involves three main vectors, the following being:  the development and implementation of policies promoting the dissemination of the financial sector, through the financial education of consumers, so that they take advantage of the virtues of financial services;  competition between financial service providers with a view to encouraging price reduction and promoting innovation; and  protection for consumers with low financial literacy against unfair commercial practices. In the sphere of institutional strengthening , also in view of the design and further materialization of the National Strategy for Financial Inclusion, the Bank of Mozambique also created this year, the Department of Behavioral Supervision, whose competencies include the promotion of initiatives to increase the levels of information and financial education of the public. Distinguished guests, The bankof our economy, through the expansion of financial services to rural areas, both through the physical presence of agencies and through the use of information and communication technologies, has been producing significant results with regard to increasing the levels of access and use of financial services by the population. Indicators of demographic access to bank branches, measured by the availability of these per 100,000 inhabitants, and those of geographical access , which is measured on the basis of the number of agencies per 10,000 square kilometres show that there have been improvements in financial inclusion rates, currently accounting for 4 branches for every 100,000 inhabitants against 2 in 2005 and 7 agencies for every 10,000 square kilometres versus 3 in 2005, respectively. 4 Governor's Speech 4 Governor's Speech The figures mentioned above certainly reflect encouraging growth, which we must all be proud of and, above all, inspire us to continue our efforts so far. It should be said that within the framework of the National Strategy for the Development of the Financial Sector we have defined as one of the goals to achieve the improvement of the level of financial inclusion for a comprehensive 35% of the adult population by 2022, which gives us a clear idea of the scale of the challenges that are still ahead. The Financial Education Program, which we are pleased to launch today, aims primarily at complementing and consolidating efforts to expand financial services to rural areas. We are convinced that by promoting financial education, we are providing our fellow citizens not only with tools for a broader understanding of concepts, for the dissemination of knowledge about what the financial market provides, but also actively contributing to the training of individuals and society, responsible and committed to the future, to the extent that they will appropriate this knowledge, skills and values thus becoming aware of the opportunities and risks associated with financial products and services. The Financial Education Program was conceived with the purpose of covering all population segments of the country. Its implementation will comprise two phases: a pilot phase, which runs from 2014 to 2016, in which on an experimental basis we will implement several communication strategies and, in the finally, we will evaluate it and define ways of improving in the second phase, from 2017 to 2022, we will focus on better replication of strategies to the fullest extent national territory. In this second phase, we plan to ensure that primary and secondary curriculum plans include specific financial education subjects. For this desideratum, the Ministry of Education is, of course, an essential partner. For the success of the actions envisaged, we count on the involvement and active participation of various actors, including credit institutions and financial corporations operating in our country and other national, foreign and international partners, of which are examples of the government institutions represented here and the media, which will have a role of importance in the dissemination of educational messages. The memoranda of understanding with RM and TVM, whose signature we have just witnessed, represent the firm commitment that the two public media outlets assume in the framework of their noble role of serving citizens, ensuring that they exercise their constitutional right to information, in this case of a financial nature. We are fully aware that keeping the public properly informed and trained , including in the field of financial education, is also a matter of interest to other media institutions, so we continue to rely on their valuable collaboration under conditions that sustainability of any partnership for such a programme. In this context, it is worth highlighting the role of the Institute of Social Communication and of the entire community radio network in the dissemination of the financial education programme in rural areas of the country, using local languages, which will certainly ensure greater coverage and the expected impact on the Mozambican population. Therefore, we will bet on a simple language that transforms technical materials into information that is easy to understand. The first theme chosen for our financial education programme is 'Savings', a choice that stems from the recognition of its importance as a means for the creation and multiplication of wealth. In fact, in savings is the gain, both for those who entrust their money to banks, or from the perspective of financial intermediation, as a driver of investment. In this regard, I am pleased to inform you that the Bank of Mozambique, with the support of national and international partners , including the German government, through KfW, intends to this year,in Mozambique , the celebration of The World Savings Day, which is celebrated on the last working day of October. Initiatives associated with the celebration of Savings Day will target citizens of all ages, with particular attention to children and young people, aged 6-18 of age, as well as teachers, given the privileged position they occupy in society, as disseminators of information and agents of induction of behavioral changes. In terms of strategy, awareness will be made in certain primary and secondary schools in the cities of Maputo and Matola, on 31 October current. In this context, I would like to highlight the initiatives that have been carried out by the government, through the Ministry of State Administration, which have contributed to the dissemination, throughout the our vast territory, from messages on the role of saving for families and the national economy. I strongly appeal to all present to join in the actions that will take place on the occasion of the commemoration of that date and to make their contributions to the materialisation of the various initiatives planned in the framework of this event. The active engagement of commercial banks and credit institutions in general in advertising initiatives that go beyond the mere scope of banking marketing and are better placed in training actions -- even if dispersed -- on aspects of the financial and banking area, is the translation of the assume, in the banking sector banks, in order to be relevant, cannot focus so so on short-term profit and profitability. When buying and selling money, when trading financial products and services, the activity of banks clearly emerges a social responsibility which derives from the transversal nature of the means that they handle and require that particular attention should be paid to consumers , end-users of the banking industry and their preparation to access the banking industry services provided, with a view to maximising their use. At the Bank of Mozambique, we cultivate awareness of the need to involve all available resources, exploring all possible means and mobilizing the potential partnerships with which we count, since financial education goes much further than the central bank and the country's credit institutions can do in the field of training and advocacy. Financial education is therefore a comprehensive long-term process, which presupposes the active participation of all. At this time, I have the honor to announce the formal and public launch of the Financial Education Program promoted by the Bank of Mozambique and I end by inviting those present and all those who accompany us through the means of communication to attend the following presentation. Thank you so much for your attention!
text_original: DISCURSO DE SUA EXCELNCIA O GOVERNADOR DO BANCO DE MOAMBIQUE POR OCASIO DO LANAMENTO DO PROGRAMA DE EDUCAO FINANCEIRA DO BANCO DE MOAMBIQUE MAPUTO, 22 DE OUTUBRO DE 2014 1 BM | Discurso do Governador Senhor Vice-Ministro da Administrao Estatal, Excelncia, Senhores Membros do Corpo Diplomtico, Excelncias, Senhor Vice-Governador do Banco de Moambique, Excelncia, Senhores Administradores do Banco de Moambique, Senhor Dr. Adriano Maleiane, Antigo Governador do Banco de Moambique, Senhores Presidentes de Conselhos de Administrao e Comisses Executivas de instituies financeiras, Senhor Presidente da CTA, Senhores Antigos Administradores do Banco de Moambique, Senhores Directores Nacionais, Senhores Directores do Banco de Moambique, Senhores Representantes de instituies parceiras de cooperao, Senhores Membros do Comit de Coordenao do Sistema Nacional de Pagamentos, Senhores Representantes de rgos de comunicao social, Senhor Presidente do Sindicato Nacional dos Empregados Bancrios, Senhor Presidente da Associao dos Trabalhadores do Banco de Moambique, Senhor Representante do Comit de Empresa do Sindicato Nacional dos Empregados Bancrios no Banco de Moambique, Distintos convidados, Minhas Senhoras, Meus Senhores,  com grande emoo que em nome do Conselho de Administrao e em meu nome pessoal sado a presena de V. Exas., que muito nos honra e distingue, nesta cerimnia de lanamento do Programa de Educao Financeira do Banco de Moambique. Quero, em particular, agradecer a presena de Suas Excelncias o Ministro da Educao e Vice- Ministro da Administrao Estatal, que uma vez mais vm testemunhar o comprometimento do poder executivo com a causa da educao financeira no nosso pas. Estendo os meus especiais agradecimentos aos distintos representantes de instituies de crdito e sociedades financeiras, aos nossos parceiros de cooperao e aos rgos de comunicao social, que constituem importantes contrapartes do Banco de Moambique no cumprimento das suas mltiplas atribuies. Minhas Senhoras, Meus Senhores, Em Abril de 2013, o Governo da Repblica de Moambique aprovou a Estratgia para o Desenvolvimento do Sector Financeiro 2013-2022, visando o desenvolvimento de um sector financeiro slido, diversificado, competitivo e inclusivo, que oferea ao pblico e s empresas, particularmente s micro e pequenas empresas, o acesso a uma ampla gama de servios financeiros adequados e de elevada qualidade. No quadro dessa Estratgia, coube ao Banco de Moambique a responsabilidade de coordenar a elaborao da Estratgia Nacional para a Incluso Financeira. Nesse contexto, no presente ano foram aprovados os termos de referncia e o plano de aco contendo os princpios que serviro de base para a elaborao da Estratgia Nacional para a Incluso Financeira, cuja materializao passa por trs principais vectores, a saber:  o desenvolvimento e a implementao de polticas que promovam a divulgao do sector financeiro, atravs da educao financeira dos consumidores, para que tirem partido das virtudes dos servios financeiros;  a concorrncia entre os provedores de servios financeiros, tendo em vista encorajar a reduo dos preos e promover a inovao; e  a proteco aos consumidores com baixa literacia financeira contra prticas comerciais desleais. Na esfera do reforo institucional, tendo ainda em vista o desenho e a ulterior materializao da Estratgia Nacional para a Incluso Financeira, o Banco de Moambique criou, tambm este ano, o Departamento de Superviso Comportamental, cujas competncias incluem a promoo de iniciativas em prol do incremento dos nveis de informao e educao financeira do pblico. Distintos convidados, A bancarizao da nossa economia, atravs da expanso dos servios financeiros s zonas rurais, quer atravs da presena fsica de agncias, quer com o recurso s tecnologias de informao e comunicao, tem vindo a produzir resultados assinalveis no que diz respeito ao incremento dos nveis de acesso e uso de servios financeiros por parte da populao. Os indicadores de acesso demogrfico a agncias bancrias, medido atravs da disponibilidade destas por cada 100 mil habitantes, e os de acesso geogrfico, que se afere com base no nmero de agncias em cada 10 mil quilmetros quadrados mostram que se tem vindo a registar melhorias nos ndices de incluso financeira, situando-se actualmente em 4 agncias para cada 100 mil habitantes contra 2 em 2005 e 7 agncias para cada 10 mil quilmetros quadrados contra 3 em 2005, respectivamente. 4 BM | Discurso do Governador Os nmeros atrs referidos reflectem, sem dvida, um crescimento encorajador, que a todos nos deve encher de orgulho e, sobretudo, inspirar a prosseguir os esforos at aqui empreendidos. Refira-se que no mbito da Estratgia Nacional para o Desenvolvimento do Sector Financeiro definimos como uma das metas a alcanar a melhoria do nvel de incluso financeira para uma abrangncia de 35% da populao adulta at 2022, o que nos d uma clara ideia da dimenso dos ingentes desafios que ainda temos pela frente. O Programa de Educao Financeira, que hoje temos o prazer de lanar, visa fundamentalmente complementar e consolidar os esforos de expanso dos servios financeiros s zonas rurais. Estamos convictos de que, ao promovermos a educao financeira, estamos a fornecer aos nossos concidados no apenas ferramentas para uma mais ampla compreenso dos conceitos, para a difuso de conhecimentos sobre o que o mercado financeiro disponibiliza, como tambm estamos a contribuir activamente para a formao dos indivduos e da sociedade, responsveis e comprometidos com o futuro, na medida em que se apropriaro desses conhecimentos, competncias e valores tornando-se, assim, conscientes das oportunidades e dos riscos associados aos produtos e servios financeiros. O Programa de Educao Financeira foi concebido com o propsito de abranger todos os segmentos populacionais do Pas. A sua implementao compreender duas fases: uma fase piloto, que vai de 2014 a 2016, em que a ttulo experimental iremos implementar diversas estratgias comunicacionais e, no fim, procederemos  sua avaliao e definiremos formas de melhoria para, na segunda fase, de 2017 a 2022, apostarmos numa melhor replicao das estratgias em toda a extenso do territrio nacional. Nessa segunda fase, prevemos assegurar que os planos curriculares dos nveis primrio e secundrio incluam matrias especficas de educao financeira. Para esse desiderato, o Ministrio da Educao constitui, naturalmente, um parceiro essencial. Para o sucesso das aces previstas, contamos com o envolvimento e activa participao de actores diversos, entre os quais as instituies de crdito e sociedades financeiras que operam no nosso pas e outros parceiros nacionais, estrangeiros e internacionais, de que so exemplos as instituies do governo aqui representadas e os rgos de comunicao social, que tero um papel de grande relevo na difuso das mensagens educativas. Os memorandos de entendimento com a RM e com a TVM, cuja assinatura acabamos de presenciar, representam o firme compromisso que os dois rgos pblicos de comunicao social assumem no quadro do seu nobre papel de servir os cidados, assegurando-lhes o exerccio do seu direito constitucional  informao, neste caso de carcter financeiro. Temos a plena conscincia de que manter o pblico devidamente informado e formado, incluindo no domnio da educao financeira, constitui tambm matria de interesse de outras instituies de comunicao social, pelo que continuamos a contar com a sua valiosa colaborao dentro de condies que permitam sustentabilidade de qualquer parceria para um programa desta natureza. Neste contexto, cumpre destacar o papel do Instituto de Comunicao Social e de toda a rede de rdios comunitrias na divulgao do programa de educao financeira nas zonas rurais do pas, usando as lnguas locais, o que certamente ir assegurar uma maior abrangncia e o esperado impacto na populao moambicana. Por isso, apostaremos numa linguagem simples que transforme matrias tcnicas em informao de fcil entendimento. O primeiro tema eleito para o nosso programa de educao financeira  A Poupana, escolha que decorre do reconhecimento da sua importncia como meio para a criao e multiplicao de riqueza. Na verdade, na poupana est o ganho, quer para quem confia o seu dinheiro aos bancos, quer na perspectiva de intermediao financeira, enquanto impulsionador do investimento. A este propsito, apraz-me informar que o Banco de Moambique, com o apoio de parceiros nacionais e internacionais, de entre os quais o governo alemo, atravs da KfW, pretende introduzir no presente ano, em Moambique, a celebrao do Dia Mundial da Poupana, que se comemora no ltimo dia til do ms de Outubro. As iniciativas associadas  celebrao do Dia da Poupana visaro cidados de todas as idades, com particular ateno para as crianas e os jovens, entre os 6 e os 18 anos de idade, bem assim professores, dada a posio privilegiada que ocupam na sociedade, enquanto disseminadores de informao e agentes de induo de mudanas comportamentais. Em termos de estratgia, a sensibilizao ser feita em determinadas escolas primrias e secundrias das cidades de Maputo e Matola, no dia 31 de Outubro corrente. Neste contexto, quero destacar as iniciativas que tm sido levadas a cabo pelo governo, atravs do Ministrio da Administrao Estatal, as quais tm contribudo para a disseminao, ao longo do nosso vasto territrio, de mensagens sobre o papel da poupana para as famlias e para a economia nacional. Apelo vivamente a todos os presentes a associarem-se s aces que tero lugar por ocasio da comemorao dessa data e a darem as suas contribuies para a materializao das diversas iniciativas projectadas no quadro desse evento. O engajamento activo dos bancos comerciais e das instituies de crdito em geral em iniciativas publicitrias que ultrapassam o mero mbito do marketing de servios bancrios e melhor se colocam em aces de formao - ainda que dispersas - sobre aspectos da rea financeira e bancria,  a traduo do assumir, no sector bancrio nacional, de que os bancos, para serem relevantes, no se podem focalizar apenas no lucro e na rentabilidade de curto prazo. Ao comprar e vender o dinheiro, ao transaccionar produtos e servios financeiros, da actividade dos bancos emerge nitidamente uma responsabilidade social que deriva do carcter transversal dos meios que manuseiam e impe que na estratgia de cada banco se preste uma especial ateno aos consumidores, aos utilizadores finais da indstria bancria e  sua preparao para aceder aos servios prestados, na perspectiva de maximizarem o uso dos mesmos. No Banco de Moambique, cultivamos a conscincia da necessidade de envolver todos os recursos disponveis, explorando todos os meios possveis e mobilizando as potenciais parcerias com que contar, uma vez que a educao financeira vai muito mais alm do que o banco central e as instituies de crdito do pas podem fazer no domnio da formao e da advocacia. A educao financeira  pois um processo abrangente de longo prazo, que pressupe a participao activa de todos. Neste momento, tenho a honra de anunciar o lanamento formal e pblico do Programa de Educao Financeira promovido pelo Banco de Moambique e termino convidando os presentes e a todos quantos nos acompanham atravs dos meios de comunicao a assistirem  apresentao que se seguir. Muito obrigado pela vossa ateno!

Title: World Savings Day
text: Ms. Fatima Moiane, Principal of The Primary School September 7 Representatives of the Presidents of the Municipal Councils of Maputo and Matola, Gentlemen members of the Diplomatic Corps, Excellencies Mr . Administrators of the Bank of Mozambique, Presidents of executive committees of credit institutions and other representatives of financial institutions, Representatives of the Ministries of Education, Finance and Industry and Trade, Mr Director of KFW in Mozambique, Director of GIZ, Madam Director of the ICC, Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Dear Teachers, Staff and Pupils of The Primary School September 7 Representatives of the media, Distinguished Guests, Ladies, gentlemen, On behalf of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique and on my own behalf, I would like to greet you all and wish you a warm welcome to this world savings day celebration ceremony. In a special way, I would like to thank the honorable presence of His Excellencies the Members of the Diplomatic Corps represented here, and thus reiterate our appreciation for the continued and multifaceted support of the institutions and countries that initiatives aimed at the economic and social development of our country. I express my special thanks to the distinguished representatives of financial institutions, to our cooperation partners and to the media represented here, for their important role in fulfilling the mission entrusted to the Bank of Mozambique. I would also like to warmly greet the Board of this school, the teachers and staff in general whose role in the formation of current and future generations of Mozambicans is preponderant. I take this opportunity to reiterate our deep appreciation and recognition of your noble role as trainers and agents of transformation, dissemination of knowledge and creation of skills and attitudes. I greet with prominence the students of this school, who represent students from all over our country. In you we place hope on ever better days, welfare days, which will certainly be achieved with your dedication to studies, combined with the assimilation of education they receive from parents and society in general. Dear guests, Ladies and Gentlemen It is a reason for us to be very pleased today in this welcoming educational establishment, an institution long rooted in our beautiful capital city, which we have been through and thousands of our countrymen continue to form. The name of this institution - Primary School September 7th - touches us deeply to all of us Mozambicans. In fact, it evokes a date as important as the day of the conclusion of the Lusaka Agreements. In particular, I must remind you that the history of the Bank of Mozambique, our central bank and issuing, is also closely linked to 7 September. In fact, clause 16 of the Lusaka Agreements provided for the creation in the country of a central bank, which was to be born on 17 May 1975, shortly before proclamation of our independence. The 7 th of September School was drawn among many other educational institutions to host, for the first time in the country, the celebrations of World Savings Day. The School Board is to be congratulated 7 September, the teachers and staff are to be congratulated and the students are to be congratulated, who, as we said, are our future and our hope! I must thank deeply on behalf of the Bank of Mozambique for the hospitality of the community of this School, allowing us from this place to go to the whole country on this special date. Especially to our students, I must remind you that our government approved in April 2013 a document called the Strategy for the Development of the Financial Sector, with the main objective of improving access to and use financial services by an increasing number of Mozambicans. As you know, today the operations of moving money can also be made even where there is no banks. You can use computer or telephone. We want many people, many Mozambicans to benefit from these services, who can have close to themselves and use these services. That's what we call financial inclusion. At the Bank of Mozambique, which is the bank of all of us, we have a responsibility to design and implement a financial education program. This program has already begun. If you look at the television, you will notice information that aims to convey various knowledge related to the activities of commercial banks such as deposit, bank account, savings, loan, among others. The first theme we have chosen for our financial education programme is 'Savings'. Actually, saving is good! It is good that everyone has a bank account where to deposit their savings. This is good for everyone , it's good for everyone, it's good for the country. The money we left deposited in the banks we use when we need it. If we leave it on time, for example three months, that money bears fruit, which we call interest. On the other hand, people who do not have money but need it to invest, for example, buy tractor for machamba, build schools, vehicles and other goods, go to banks and borrow that money and use it for their own benefit and also the country goes out to earn. We have chosen a school as the most suitable place to introduce today, 31 October, the celebration of World Savings Day, which will be celebrated every year on the last working day of October. In this context, lectures on savings and the means of realization of savings, such as term deposits and other means, are planned, among other achievements. While we intend to gradually cover citizens of all ages across the country , we now pay special attention to children and young people, between 6 and young 18 years old, just like our dear teachers. Teachers occupy a privileged position in society, while disseminators of information and agents of induction of behavioral changes. We want them to spread the message of saving as a factor that creates and multiplies wealth. It is also our goal that you children, adolescents and young people grow up with the culture of savings. That's why we're here with you today! We want you to spend the message at home, parents and in your circle of friends today that the savings are that there is no bright future, no investment without savings. For this year, awareness will be made in certain primary and secondary schools in the cities of Maputo and Matola a total of 45. We hope that your books in the future will include subjects on financial education. For the success of these and other actions envisaged, we therefore count on the involvement and active participation of various actors, including schools, credit institutions and financial corporations operating in our country and other national, foreign and international partners, of which are examples of the institutions represented here and the media, which will have a role indispensable in the dissemination of educational messages. In this context, allow me to address a special greeting to the Ministry of Education and the Directorates of Education of the City and Province of Maputo for the valuable collaboration to carry out this event through coordination with the schools that during this school block host various activities promoted by various credit institutions, under the accompaniment of the Bank mozambique. In this context, a word of appreciation goes naturally to commercial banks and credit institutions in general represented here by taking action through actions that go beyond the mere scope of banking marketing and better to train themselves - albeit dispersed - on aspects of banking. This position of the banks expresses their commitment to bet not only on activities focused on profit and short-term profitability, but also on social responsibility. Our special thanks go to the German government which, through KfW, has secured the technical and financial support necessary for the celebration of this date. This gesture encourages us because we understand it as a bet and belief of the German government in the macroeconomic stability of our country to which it has been contributing to the promotion of financial education. Financial savings are a key instrument for the country's socio-economic development. In this context, the celebration of World Savings Day in Mozambique represents a complement to the initiatives of the government that, through the Ministry of State Administration, has been promoting campaigns to promote savings in the country, whose official launch ceremony had the honor of directed by His Excellency President of the Republic in 2011 in the Province of Manica. In this context and to finish, I have the honor to announce the formal and public launch of the celebration of the World Savings Day in Mozambique inserted in the Financial Education Program promoted by the Bank of Mozambique Thank you so much for your attention!
text_original: DISCURSO DE SUA EXCELNCIA O GOVERNADOR DO BANCO DE MOAMBIQUE POR OCASIO DA CELEBRAO DO DIA MUNDIAL DA POUPANA MAPUTO, 31 DE OUTUBRO DE 2014 Senhora Ftima Moiane, Directora da Escola Primria 7 de Setembro Senhores Representantes dos Presidentes dos Conselhos Municipais de Maputo e Matola, Senhores membros do Corpo Diplomtico, Excelncias Senhores Administradores do Banco de Moambique, Senhores Presidentes de Comisses Executivas de Instituies de Crdito e demais representantes de instituies financeiras, Senhores Representante dos Ministrios da Educao, Finanas e Indstria e Comrcio, Senhor Director da KFW em Moambique, Senhor Director do GIZ, Senhora Directora do ICC, Senhores Directores do Banco de Moambique, Estimados Professores, funcionrios e alunos da Escola Primria 7 de Setembro Senhores Representantes de rgos de comunicao social, Distintos convidados, Minhas Senhoras, Meus Senhores, Em nome do Conselho de Administrao do Banco de Moambique e em meu nome pessoal, gostaria de saudar a todos e desejar-lhes calorosos votos de boas-vindas a esta cerimnia de celebrao do Dia Mundial da Poupana. Quero, de forma especial, agradecer a honrosa presena de Suas Excelncias os Membros do Corpo Diplomtico aqui representados, bem assim reiterar o nosso apreo pelo contnuo e multifacetado apoio das instituies e pases que representam a iniciativas visando o desenvolvimento econmico e social do nosso Pas. Estendo os meus especiais agradecimentos aos distintos representantes de instituies financeiras, aos nossos parceiros de cooperao e aos rgos de comunicao social aqui representados, pelo papel preponderante que desempenham no cumprimento da misso incumbida ao Banco de Moambique. Gostaria tambm de saudar vivamente a Direco desta escola, os professores e os funcionrios em geral cujo papel na formao das actuais e futuras geraes de moambicanos  preponderante. Aproveito esta ocasio para reiterar o nosso profundo apreo e reconhecimento ao vosso nobre papel como formadores e agentes de transformao, de difuso de conhecimentos e de criao de habilidades e de atitudes. Sado com destaque os alunos desta escola, que representam os alunos de todo o nosso pas. Em vocs ns depositamos a esperana em dias cada vez melhores, dias bem-estar, o que certamente se conseguir com a vossa dedicao aos estudos, conjugada com a assimilao da educao que recebem dos pais e da sociedade em geral. Caros convidados, Minhas Senhoras Meus Senhores Constitui para ns motivo de enorme satisfao encontramo- nos hoje reunidos neste acolhedor estabelecimento de ensino, instituio h muito enraizada nesta nossa bela cidade capital, por que passaram e continuam a formar-se milhares de nossos compatriotas. O nome desta instituio - Escola Primria 7 de Setembro  toca-nos profundamente a todos ns moambicanos. Na verdade, evoca uma data to importante como foi o dia da celebrao dos Acordos de Lusaka. De modo especial, devo recordar-vos que a histria do Banco de Moambique, o nosso banco central e emissor, est tambm bastante associada ao 7 de Setembro. Na verdade, a clusula 16 dos Acordos de Lusaka previa a criao no pas dum banco central, o qual viria a nascer em 17 de Maio de 1975, pouco antes da proclamao da nossa independncia. A Escola 7 de Setembro foi sorteada entre tantas outras instituies de ensino para acolher, pela primeira vez no Pas, as celebraes do Dia Mundial da Poupana. Est de parabns a Direco da Escola 7 de Setembro, esto de parabns os professores e os funcionrios e esto de parabns os alunos, que, como referimos, so o nosso futuro e a nossa esperana! Devo agradecer profundamente em nome do Banco de Moambique a hospitalidade da comunidade desta Escola, permitindo-nos que a partir deste lugar nos dirijamos ao pas inteiro, nesta data especial. Especialmente aos nossos alunos, devo recordar que o nosso governo aprovou, em Abril de 2013, um documento chamado Estratgia para o Desenvolvimento do Sector Financeiro, com o objectivo principal de melhorar o acesso e o uso dos servios financeiros por parte de um cada vez maior nmero de moambicanos. 6 BM | Discurso do Governador Queremos que muitas pessoas, muitos moambicanos beneficiem desses servios, que possam ter perto de si e usem esses servios. A isso chamamos de incluso financeira. No Banco de Moambique, que  o banco de todos ns, temos a responsabilidade de traar e implementar um programa de educao financeira. Esse programa j iniciou. Se olharem para a televiso, notaro informaes que tm por objectivo transmitir conhecimentos vrios relacionados com as actividades dos bancos comerciais como depsito, conta bancria, poupana, emprstimo, entre outras. O primeiro tema que escolhemos para o nosso programa de educao financeira  A Poupana. Na verdade, poupar  bom!  bom que cada um tenha uma conta bancria onde depositar as suas poupanas. Isso  bom para cada um,  bom para todos,  bom para o pas. O dinheiro que deixamos depositado nos bancos usamos quando dele precisamos. Se o deixarmos a prazo, por exemplo trs meses, esse dinheiro d frutos, que chamamos de juros. Por outro lado, as pessoas que no tm dinheiro mas precisam dele para investir, por exemplo, comprar tractor para machamba, construir escolas, viaturas e outros bens, vo aos bancos e pedem emprestado esse dinheiro e utilizam-no para o seu prprio benefcio e tambm o pas sai a ganhar. Escolhemos uma escola como o local mais adequado para introduzir hoje, dia 31 de Outubro, a celebrao do Dia Mundial da Poupana, que passar a ser comemorado todos os anos no ltimo dia til do ms de Outubro. Neste contexto, esto previstas, entre outras realizaes, palestras sobre a poupana e sobre os meios de realizao da mesma, tais como os depsitos a prazo e outros meios. Embora tencionemos abranger, de forma gradual, os cidados de todas as idades em todo o pas, neste momento prestamos especial ateno s crianas e aos jovens, entre os 6 e os 18 anos de idade, bem assim aos nossos queridos professores. Os professores ocupam uma posio privilegiada na sociedade, enquanto disseminadores de informao e agentes de induo de mudanas comportamentais. Queremos que difundam a mensagem da poupana enquanto factor que cria e multiplica a riqueza.  tambm nosso objectivo que vocs crianas, adolescentes e jovens cresam com a cultura de poupana.  por isso que hoje estamos aqui convosco! Queremos que vocs desde hoje passem em casa, aos pais e no vosso crculo de amigos a mensagem de que na poupana  que reside o ganho e que no h futuro risonho, nem investimento sem poupana. Para o presente ano, a sensibilizao ser feita em determinadas escolas primrias e secundrias das cidades de Maputo e Matola num total de 45. Esperamos que os vossos livros no futuro incluam matrias sobre educao financeira. Para o sucesso destas e doutras aces previstas, contamos, pois, com o envolvimento e activa participao de actores diversos, entre os quais as escolas, as instituies de crdito e sociedades financeiras que operam no nosso pas e outros parceiros nacionais, estrangeiros e internacionais, de que so exemplos as instituies aqui representadas e os rgos de comunicao social, que tero um papel indispensvel na difuso de mensagens educativas. Neste contexto, permitam-me enderear uma saudao especial ao Ministrio da Educao e s Direces de Educao da Cidade e Provncia de Maputo pela valiosa colaborao para a concretizao deste evento atravs da coordenao com as escolas que durante esta quadra celebrativa acolhem vrias actividades promovidas por diversas instituies de crdito, sob o acompanhamento do Banco de Moambique. Neste mbito, uma palavra de apreo vai naturalmente aos bancos comerciais e s instituies de crdito em geral aqui representadas que aderiram a esta iniciativa atravs de aces que ultrapassam o mero mbito do marketing de servios bancrios e melhor se colocam em aces de formao - ainda que dispersas - sobre aspectos da rea bancria. Esta postura dos bancos expressa o seu cometimento em apostar no apenas em actividades focalizadas no lucro e na rentabilidade de curto prazo, mas tambm de responsabilidade social. Os nossos agradecimentos especiais vo para o governo alemo que, atravs da KfW, assegurou o apoio tcnico e financeiro necessrio para a celebrao desta data. Este gesto encoraja-nos pois entendemo-lo como uma aposta e crena do governo alemo na estabilidade macroeconmica do nosso pas para a qual tem estado a contribuir com a promoo da educao financeira. A poupana financeira constitui um instrumento-chave para o desenvolvimento socioeconmico do pas. Neste mbito, a celebrao do Dia Mundial da Poupana em Moambique representa um complemento das iniciativas do governo que, atravs do Ministrio da Administrao Estatal, tem estado a promover campanhas de promoo de poupana no pas, cuja cerimnia de lanamento oficial teve a honra de ser dirigida por Sua Excelncia Presidente da Repblica, no ano de 2011, na Provncia de Manica. Neste mbito e para finalizar, tenho a honra de anunciar o lanamento formal e pblico da celebrao do Dia Mundial da Poupana em Moambique inserido no Programa de Educao Financeira promovido pelo Banco de Moambique Muito obrigado pela vossa ateno!

Title: Speech at the Inauguration of Moza Agency in Inhambane City
text: SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE DR. ERNESTO GOUVEIA GOVE On THE OCCASION OF THE INAUGURATION OF THE MOZA AGENCY IN THE CITY OF INHAMBANE INHAMBANE, JANUARY 8, 2016 SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE DR. ERNESTO GOUVEIA GOVE On THE OCCASION OF THE INAUGURATION OF THE MOZA AGENCY IN THE CITY OF INHAMBANE INHAMBANE, JANUARY 8, 2016 Governor of Inhambane Province, Excellency Mr President of inhambane City Council, Exmos. Members of the Provincial Government of Inhambane, Members of the Board of Directors and the Executive Committee and Directors of Moza, Distinguished Traditional Authorities of the City of Inhambane Distinguished Guests, Ladies, gentlemen, I would first like to thank, on behalf of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique and on my own behalf, to thank the invitation addressed to me by the Moza Administration to witness the opening ceremony of the Moza Agency in this City of Inhambane. I greet the shareholders, the Board of Directors and the Executive Committee of Moza, for this initiative inserted in its business plan. I also congratulate you on the vision that they had to create and maintain a largely national capital financial institution about seven years ago, which underlines the ability of Mozambicans to undertake and take a major role in our financial sector. We are proud to see on the ground the ideas and efforts of our compatriots translated into success, with an impact on the lives of citizens. I would like to address my special greetings to the Government of the Province of Inhambane and to the authorities of the City Council of this City for the invaluable support and collaboration that they have continuously been providing to the financial institutions operating in this part of the country, allowing the expansion of the banking network and also the elevation of levels of access and use of financial services, thus contributing to the increase of the financial inclusion of populations. I extend my greetings to the economic agents, the main recipients of this undertaking, with which from today they are now counting. We are on the threshold of a new year in which, with our eyes set on the future, each and every one of us is called to make our contribution to an ever better Mozambique. Moza's gesture, like other initiatives of the kind of financial institutions operating in our country, fits into this broad and noble common project. The role, with constitutional consecration, reserved for banks is financial intermediation, which involves the collection of savings necessary for the financing of investments, with a special focus on small and medium-sized enterprises, as important sources of income generation and employment. Our Government and the Bank of Mozambique continue to encourage and stimulate the growth of the banking system. Despite the path still to be taken, we note with satisfaction that banks have been responding with determination and responsibility to the current challenge of financial inclusion, expanding our vast territory into the banking business, in order to ensure the necessary support for the country's numerous economic and social development projects. Responding with determination and responsibility to the challenge of banking our economy means the physical expansion of bank branches across the country, also means optimising the virtualities of new information and communication technologies, including through computer networks and mobile phones reaching the most remote areas of our vast territory. Determination and responsibility also means ensuring the provision of quality services, in which the customer must always be in the spotlight, which should be complemented by literacy actions and financial education. The act we are witnessing today is, moreover, consistent with a series of measures that Moza has been taking to strengthen its presence with citizens, with results that deserve all our appreciation. As of today, Inhambane now has 34 bank branches, five of which here in this city, which occupies the second place in terms of concentration of banking institutions to province level, after the city of Maxixe. We are pleased to see gradual and sustainable growth in the financial sector, especially if we look at the figures of the beginning of 2007, when we launched the challenge of banking the economy. In fact, there were only 13 bank branches, compared to the current 34, 15 ATM and 162 POS throughout the province, against the current 71 ATM park and 478 POS. At that time, the districts of Funhalouro, Govuro, Homoine, Inharrime, Inhassoro, Jangamo, Mabote, Morrumbene and Panda did not have bank branches. It is recalled that, as part of the measures we have been taking to promote financial inclusion, in April last year we adopted the rules and criteria for opening and closing bank branches, which advocate the existence in each commercial bank of an annual and multiannual expansion plan for the opening of new branches, following criteria of geographical proportionality, i.e. for every three new branches, the opening of the first should take place in one of the expressly mentioned in the Notice of the Bank of Mozambique on the matter and the others are at the choice of each bank. In particular case of the province of Inhambane, we have districts such as Funhalouro, Mabote and Panda still without bank branches, which certainly deprives our compatriots of access to essential banking products and services, namely the payment of salaries and the deposit of their savings, closer to their places of residence and work. We encourage financial institutions to increase their scope for all districts, not only in this province , but of our entire country. The city of Inhambane has strong economic potential, particularly in the areas of tourism and fishing, with still significant space to assert themselves and consolidate in the context of the province and the national economy as a whole. The call of the Central Bank is addressed to all economic agents, in order to add synergies to produce more and progressively reduce imports, as well as multiply the activities generating foreign exchange for the country, increasing exports. The country has conditions to significantly reduce the current level of economic dependence on the outside world. We need to bravely face the current constraints to effective transformation economic and social environment that favours the appropriate business environment, driving investment, production, productivity and employment. Ladies Distinguished Ladies Guests On this occasion, I address a message of encouragement to economic operators and the population of Inhambane to make the best use of available banking establishments, in particular for their deposits, payments or transfers. The channeling of savings to banks represents an important contribution to the country's economy and a safe investment for depositors themselves. The movement of money outside the banking system is detrimental to the economy, involves considerable risks, including the damage of banknotes, the replacement of which costs foreign currency to the country. I end by thanking the attention of all those present and with repeated words of congratulations for the inauguration of this counter, extended to Moza's employees, agents and, in general, all potential beneficiaries of the financial products and services it will provide. Thank you very much!
