Title: Intervention at the Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding for the Division of Responsibility in Cash Cycle Management between the Central Bank and Credit Institutions
text: SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA On THE OCCASION OF THE SIGNING OF THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING FOR THE DIVISION OF RESPONSIBILITYIN THE MANAGEMENT OF THE CASH CYCLE BETWEEN THE BM AND CREDIT INSTITUTIONS AAAPUTO, MARCH 4, 2020 Honourable Members of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Your Excellese President of the Mozambican Association of Banks, Honourable Representatives of credit institutions, Distinguished Guests, Ladies Ladies and gentlemen, first of all I want, on behalf of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, to thank you for your presence on this important occasion that marks the beginning of a new era of treasury function. 2nd Proceed today the signing of the Memorandum of Understanding between the Bank of Mozambique and credit institutions for the division of responsibilities in the management of the cash cycle, a fact that is of importance in the process of cash recirculation in our country. The agreement we have just signed will help modernise the management of the cash cycle, promoting greater efficiency by ensuring that the selection, counting, transport and distribution of Metical banknotes and coins are carried out correctly and at low cost. Soon, appropriate regulations will be issued for the operationalization of the division of responsibilities. Ladies, gentlemen, As an issuing bank, it is up to the Bank of Mozambique to ensure the integrity of the Metical banknotes and coins in circulation, to monitor the level of their quality, as well as to educate the public on matters of handling and conservation of banknotes and coins. Credit institutions must, however, be required to select and verify the authenticity of cash in order to protect themselves from losses due to counterfeiting or counterfeiting and to ensure that banknotes and coins in circulation are genuine and of good quality. I end my speech by reiterating my thanks to all those present at this ceremony and i hope that all the participating institutions will be able to carry out their responsibilities with zeal, dedication and rigour. Thank you very much!

Title: Intervention at the Seminar on the Regulatory and Supervisory Framework of Cybersecurity in the Financial System in Mozambique
text: SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA ON THE OCCASION OF THE SEMINAR ON THE FRAMEWORK FOR REGULATING AND SUPERVISING CYBERSECURITY IN THE FINANCIAL SYSTEM EMMOcAMBIQUE AAAPUTO, MARCH 6, 2020 Honourable Members of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Your Honors. Representatives of credit institutions and financial corporations and other institutes present, Distinguished Guests, Ladies, and My Lords, very good morning! On behalf of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, I would like to greet all present and welcome the meeting on the regulation and supervision of cybersecurity in the financial system in Mozambique. Cyber risk is globally recognized as one of the top threats to financial markets, whose cyber incidents tend to grow in frequency and sophistication, imposing increased challenges on financial institutions, regulators and supervisors, and markets including the stock exchange. The economic costs of such events can be increased and damage, among others, the confidence of depositors, creditors, investors and the general public, as cyber risks can undermine the stability of the global financial sector. Recent cyber events and the lack of keen collective awareness of what this threat poses have accentuated the existing weaknesses to address it, so that greater awareness of the nature of cyber risks, their sources, implications and forms of mitigation is the first step in protecting ourselves against these events. The current context of cybersecurity is characterised by the following aspects:  Increasing interdependence of financial systems;  Absent or embryonic legal framework, which creates gaps in the exercise of actions leading to supervision, supervision and monitoring;  Permanent and unpredictable nature of the attacks, which requires continuous surveillance and complex implementation;  Lack of effective international cooperation for successful containment of cybercrime. Ladies, gentlemen, Let me point out the challenges that the financial system, supervisors and regulators have to face, in particular those defacing from technological development, strengthening the regulatory framework and reshaping supervisory practices. From the point of view of the banks, it is necessary to:  adopt comprehensive governance models of cyber risk that enable a comprehensive response to Timely and adequate in terms of of Incidents compliance e compliance that prudential rules and  reduce the vulnerability to incidents of adopting specific controls for the tracking of information and ensuring the security of financial institutions. From the point of view of regulatory authorities, it is pressing that the current dynamics ensure, among others, the neutrality of regulation and the identification of new risks and the consequent adoption of appropriate regulatory and supervisory initiatives. Ladies Gentlemen The relevance of cyber risk has triggered a set of actions by the Bank of Mozambique to ensure a resilient cybersecurity environment for the financial sector as a whole. As a corollary of these actions, the following stand out:  Development of a legal and regulatory framework with a view to the following objectives: o Cyber risk management; o Cooperation and sharing of information on cyber threats; and o Establishment of an analytical framework for cybersecurity supervision and reporting of cyber incidents.  Assessment of cyber resilience in the financial sector in order to determine the level of intrinsic cyber risk. We recognise that the inclusion of the financial sector and stakeholders in these initiatives, where each of the actors can contribute, is crucial to the establishment of an inclusive regulatory and supervisory framework adapted to the reality of Mozambique. Distinguished guests, The best defense of financial stability involves the existence of a regulation that ensures cyber resilience, as well as the adoption of the supervision of technology and appropriate skills, in line with the new risks and increasingly sophisticated. In the meantime, we are aware that cybersecurity is a responsibility that we must all assume, as its threats and risks go beyond physical boundaries and geographical boundaries, which requires a collective and coordinated response. Thank you very much!

Em nome do Banco de Moambique e em meu nome, quero saudar a todos os presentes e dar as boas-vindas ao encontro sobre a regulao e superviso da cibersegurana no sistema financeiro em Moambique. 0 risco ciberntico  globalmente reconhecido como umas das ameaas de topo aos mercados financeiros, cujos incidentes cibernticos tendem a crescer em frequncia e sofisticao, impondo desafios acrescidos s instituies financeiras, aos reguladores e supervisores e aos mercados incluindo  bolsa de valores. Os custos econmicos de tais eventos podem ser avultados e danificar, entre outros, a confiana dos depositantes, credores, investidores e do pblico em geral, na medida em que os riscos cibernticos podem minar a estabilidade do sector financeiro global. Os recentes eventos cibernticos e a falta de conscincia colectiva apurada sobre o que esta ameaa representa acentuaram as fragilidades existentes para a enfrentar, pelo que, uma maior consciencializao sobre a natureza dos riscos cibernticos, suas fontes, implicaes e formas de mitigao  o primeiro passo para nos protegermos contra esses eventos. 0 contexto actual da cibersegurana caracteriza-se pelos seguintes aspectos:  Crescente interdependncia dos sistemas financeiros;  Enquadramento legal ausente ou embrionrio, o que cria lacunas no exerccio das aces conducentes  superviso, fiscalizao e monitoria;  Carcter permanente e imprevisvel dos ataques, o que obriga a uma vigilncia contnua e de implementao complexa; e  Ausncia de cooperao internacional efectiva para uma conteno bem-sucedida do cibercrime. Minhas Senhoras, Meus Senhores, Permitam-me que assinale os desafios que o sistema financeiro, os supervisores e os reguladores tm de enfrentar, nomeadamente, os que decorrem do desenvolvimento tecnolgico, do reforo do quadro regulatrio e da reformulao das prticas de superviso. Do ponto de vista dos bancos, mostra-se necessrio:  adoptar modelos de governao abrangentes do risco ciberntico que permitam uma resposta tempestiva e adequada em termos de incidentes, compliance e cumprimento das regras prudenciais e  reduzir a vulnerabilidade a incidentes de segurana, adoptando controlos especficos para o rastreamento de informao e garantia da segurana das instituies financeiras. Do ponto de vista das autoridades de regulao,  premente que as dinmicas em curso assegurem, entre outros, a neutralidade da regulao e a identificao de novos riscos e a consequente adopo de iniciativas regulatrias e de superviso adequadas. Minhas Senhoras, Meus Senhores, A relevncia do risco ciberntico desencadeou, por parte do Banco de Moambique, um conjunto de aces visando garantir um ambiente de cibersegurana resiliente do sector financeiro como um todo. Como corolrio dessas aces, destacam-se as seguintes:  Desenvolvimento de um quadro legal e regulamentar tendo em vista os seguintes objectivos: o Gesto do risco ciberntico; o Cooperao e partilha de informao sobre as ameaas cibernticas; e o Estabelecimento dum quadro analtico de superviso da cibersegurana e reporte de incidentes cibernticos.  Avaliao da resilincia ciberntica no sector financeiro, a fim de apurar o nvel do risco ciberntico intrnseco. Reconhecemos que a incluso do sector financeiro e das partes interessadas, nestas iniciativas, onde cada um dos intervenientes pode contribuir,  crucial para o estabelecimento de um quadro de regulao e superviso inclusivo e adaptado  realidade de Moambique. Distintos convidados, A melhor defesa da estabilidade financeira passa pela existncia de uma regulao que assegure a resilincia ciberntica, bem como a adopo da superviso de tecnologia e das competncias adequadas, consentneas com os novos riscos e cada vez mais sofisticados. Entretanto, estamos cientes de que a cibersegurana  uma responsabilidade que todos devemos assumir, na medida em que as suas ameaas e riscos extravasam as fronteiras fsicas e os limites geogrficos, o que demanda uma resposta colectiva e coordenada. Muito obrigado!

Title: Intervention at the Official Delivery Ceremony of the Julius Nyerere Complete Primary School
text: SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, ROG83RIO ZANDAMELA ON THE OCCASION OF THE OFFICIAL DELIVERY CEREMONY OF THE COMPLETE PRIMARY SCHOOL JULIUS NYERERE BEIRA, JUNE 11, 2020 Your Excellere, Provincial Director of Education, Your Honourable Ladies Administrators of the Bank of Mozambique, Madam Director of beira Branch, District Director of Education, Mr Director of The Complete Primary School Julius Nyerere Distinguished guests, Ladies, and My Lords, Very good morning! It is with great satisfaction and joy that today we carry out the official delivery of the Julius Nyerere Complete Primary School, after a rehabilitation period of about six months that contemplated, in addition to the reconstruction of nine classrooms and requalification of the administrative sector , the construction of the root of two classrooms and a multipurpose sports field, as well as a fence wall and water tanks. In this way, we believe that the minimum necessary conditions are created for children to return to classes in an appropriate and safe environment, essential aspects in the teaching and learning process. The rehabilitation of this School resulted from the ? contributions made by the workers of the Bank of Mozambique and Banco de Portugal, as part of the Fundraising Campaign to support families affected by Cyclone Idai. I take this opportunity to address our esteemed thanks to Banco de Portugal for their initiative and solidarity. We chose to rehabilitate a school because we understand that education is fundamental to the formation of human capital necessary to transform and raise the global level of competitiveness of our economy, contributing to the promotion of economic and social well-being. Ladies Gentlemen, unfortunately, this ceremony takes place at a time when our country and the world at large are in the face of the pandemic of the new coronavirus, the alias Covid-19, which has already affected millions of people globally. As education and health go hand in hand, we would like to take this opportunity to appeal to the entire student community to redouble Covid-19's prevention efforts by strictly complying with the prevention measures that have been issued by the country's competent authorities. We also call on all students to live by a true culture of preserving the school, its resources and equipment, so that it can still serve a large number of students who will pass through here. Before we finish, we would like to express our thanks to the Provincial Government of Sofala, the Provincial Directorate of Education of Sofala, the Directorate of the Complete Primary School Julius Nyerere, as well as to all teachers, students and guardians, for the support and collaboration provided during the rehabilitation process of the school. To the contractor of the work goes our special greeting for having managed to honor with the commitments made in the rehabilitation and requalification of this school within the established deadlines. I also thank the colleagues of the Bank of Mozambique who have worked this project. I would like to greet the Director of our Branch, Dr. Ruth P87tria, since it was through her efforts, initiative, commitment and commitment that we identified this school as a project to support. My thanks extend to the Administrator of the Field of Administrative Services and Heritage, Benedita Guimino for doing the proper monitoring of the works and for pressuring the workers to finish the work as planned. I also thank Administrator Silvina de Abreu for her cooperation as well as all the bank's colleagues. I end my intervention by wishing success to all students and education professionals at Julius Nyerere Complete Elementary School. Thank you very much! Beira, 11 June 2020

Title: Intervention at the Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding between the Bank of Mozambique and the Municipal Council of Inhambane City
text: INTERVENTION OF HIS EXCELLENcy THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, Dr. ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA On THE OCCASION OF THE SIGNING OF THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE AND THE MUNICIPAL COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INHAMBANE INHAMBANE, JULY 30, 2020 Mr President of the City Council of Inhambane, Honourable Lady Administrator of inhambane District, Your Excellere, President of the Municipal Assembly of the city of Inhambane, Your Excellese Administrator of the Bank of Mozambique, Distinguished guests Ladies and gentlemen, Good morning! I am very pleased to address all those present at this solemn signing ceremony of the Memorandum of Understanding between the Bank of Mozambique and the City Council of Inhambane for the construction of The Metical Square. Allow me, on behalf of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, to express my gratitude and appreciation to Mr. Benedito Guimino, President of the Municipal Council of the city of Inhambane, for his efforts to develop the municipality in a context of scarce resources. I would also like to greet all the managers and technicians of the City Council of Inhambane and the Bank of Mozambique for their selfless commitment to the materialisation of this memorandum which is of particular importance within the framework of our social responsibility. The act we have just witnessed comes at a time when we are confronted with the COVID-19 pandemic, which is causing major human and financial losses globally, and has demanded from all of us a high sense of responsibility for mitigating its effects. Ladies, gentlemen, The partnership that we have formalized today is part of the actions that the Bank of Mozambique has carried out throughout the country, in the context of the valorization, conservation and modernization of the vast heritage it has. It is our desire to emphasize and to emphasize the beauty of this city, giving a comfortable leisure space with historical significance for the citizens. Today, with the signing of this memorandum, we begin the materialization of this desire where we commit ourselves to build a Metical Square, equipped with rest benches and lampposts. It is also our commitment to finance the construction of houses for the resettlement of the 60 families who are housed in the space identified here, as well as the construction of a multi-use slaughterhouse. We understand that with the construction of Metical Square we will be helping to dignify our currency, the Metical, one of the most important symbols of our country's economic stability, ensuring that current and future generations have an example of preserving our history in the square. I end by thanking the presence of all and making a hope that the partnership we have just signed will be fruitful and lasting, benefiting, primarily, the citizens of this beautiful city, known as "land of good people". Thank you very much!

Title: Intervention at the Launch of the 2nd Edition of the Regulatory Sandbox and the Innovation Center for Fintechs
text: INTERVENTION OF HIS EXCELLENcy THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, Dr. ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA ON THE OCCASION OF THE LAUNCH OF 2. THE DOSANDBOX REGULATORY EDITION AND INNOVATION CENTERFOR FINTECHS AAAPUTO, AUGUST 10, 2020 Your Excellere, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Communications Regulatory Authority of Mozambique, Your Excellese Executive Director of the Financial Sector Deepening Mozambique, Your Excellere, President of the Mozambique Fintechs Association, Honourable Members of the Project Monitoring Committee in the Regulatory Sandbox, Your Honours, Members of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Distinguished Guests, Ladies and gentlemen, Very good morning! I would first of all like to welcome the second edition of the Regulatory Sandbox and the Fintechs Innovation Centre to the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf. This event occurs in an adverse environment, resulting from the spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, which has required, at all levels, response actions to mitigate its effects. It was in this context that the Bank of Mozambique introduced, in the National Payment System, extraordinary measures that are being implemented by banks and electronic money institutions. The second edition of the Regulatory Sandbox is part of the implementation of the National Financial Inclusion Strategy 2016-2022, which aims, among others, to increase the level of access and use of financial services for the Mozambican population. Following this objective, The Bank of Mozambique has the participation of several partners, with emphasis on the Financial Sector Deepening Mozambique, an institution with which it concluded a Memorandum of Understanding in January 2018, aiming at the development of the incubator project for Fintechs, also known as Sandbox. It is intended that this project responds to the challenges posed by technological innovation aimed at financial services, without neglecting the challenges related to risk mitigation, financial stability, consumer protection and market conduct. Ladies, Gentlemen, In May 2018, the first edition of the Regulatory Sandbox was launched, through a competition promoted by the Financial Sector Deepening Mozambique, in which five Fintechs participated, resulting in the approval of the companies Robobo, Mukuru and Paytek. It is in this context that we will today distribute the Certificate of Participation to these three entities that should then go through the licensing process. Distinguished guests, In this second edition of the Regulatory Sandbox we have the participation of seven Fintechs: Zazu Africa, Pyypl Group Itd, Trusty Computer Solutions, ACGEST, Smart Key Services, Paga and Pertence. Today's ceremony will also be marked by the launch of the innovation centre, a space that aims to bring together, among others, emerging entities, companies, regulators and providers to jointly stimulate innovation through the exchange of experience with experts from various fields. For this event we also have a presentation by the National Institute of Communications of Mozambique on the theme Blockchain and Cryptomoeda. Before i finish, I would like to address my congratulations to the elected entities to participate in this edition of the Sandbox and thank everyone for their presence. It is our expectation that new providers will emerge from this edition in the market and that together we can contribute to the promotion of financial inclusion. I declare, thus, launched the second edition of the Regulatory Sandbox and the innovation center. Thank you very much!

Title: Intervention at the Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding between the Bank of Mozambique and the Chimoio Municipal Council
text: INTERVENTION OF HIS EXCELLENcy THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, Dr. ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA On THE OCCASION OF THE SIGNING OF THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE AND THE MUNICIPAL COUNCIL OF CHIMOIO CHIMOIO, SEPTEMBER 17, 2020 Mr President of the Municipality of Chimoio, Honourable President of the Municipal Assembly of the city of Chimoio, Honourable Administrator of the Bank of Mozambique, Distinguished guests My Ladies and Gentlemen, good morning! It is with high honor that I speak in this solemn signing ceremony of the Memorandum of Understanding between the Bank of Mozambique and the Chimoio Municipal Council for the construction of The Metical Square. On behalf of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, I would like to greet Mr. Joao Carlos Gomes Ferreira, President of the Chimoio Municipal Council, for their efforts to keep the city of Chimoio clean and promote its development, even recognizing that the available resources are limited. Let me also congratulate all the managers and technicians of the Chimoio Municipal Council and the Bank of Mozambique on the hard work they have done to materialise this memorandum, which is of paramount importance within the framework of our social responsibility. The act we have just undertaken comes at a difficult time and full of uncertainties that challenge us at every moment, due to the COVID-19 pandemic. For this reason, I take this opportunity to call for the recommendations of the health authorities to be strictly observed during the various stages of implementation of our project as a way of preventing this pandemic. Ladies and gentlemen, the agreement we are celebrating today is part of the actions that the Bank of Mozambique has been developing throughout the country, with a view to valuing, conserving and modernizing its extensive architectural heritage. It is a commitment that we make with the intention of extolling the beauty of the city of Chimoio, providing an attractive leisure space, welcoming and of profound historical value for the city dwellers. With the signing of this memorandum, we have established the necessary bases for the implementation of this design where we commit ourselves to build a Metical Square, provided with rest benches, poles and lighting lamps. We believe that with this act we will also be helping to dignify our currency, the Metical, one of the most important symbols of our country's economic stability, ensuring that present and future generations have an example of preserving our history in the square. I end my speech by thanking the presence of all and convinced that today we lay the foundations for a profitable and lasting partnership relationship, which is expected to benefit mainly the citizens of this beautiful city. Thank you very much!

Minhas Senhoras Meus Senhores, 0 acordo que hoje celebramos se enquadra nas aces que o Banco de Moambique tem vindo a desenvolver em todo o pas, com vista  valorizao, conservao e modernizao do amplo patrimnio arquitectnico de que dispe.  um compromisso que assumimos com a inteno de enaltecer a beleza da cidade de Chimoio, proporcionando um espao de lazer atractivo, acolhedor e de profundo valor histrico para os citadinos. Com a assinatura deste memorando, estabelecemos as bases necessrias para a concretizao deste desgnio onde nos comprometemos a construir uma Praa do Metical, provida de bancos de repouso, postes e candeeiros de iluminao. Entendemos que com este acto estaremos, igualmente, a contribuir para dignificar a nossa moeda, o Metical, um dos smbolos mais importantes da estabilidade econmica do nosso pas, assegurando que as geraes presentes e futuras tenham na praa um exemplo de preservao da nossa histria. Termino a minha interveno agradecendo a presena de todos e convicto de que, hoje, firmamos os alicerces para uma relao de parceria proveitosa e duradoura, que se espera venha beneficiar principalmente os muncipes desta bela cidade. Muito obrigado!

Title: Intervention at the Inauguration of the Chimoio Branch
text: INTERVENTION OF HIS EXCELLENcy THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, Dr. ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA On THE OCCASION OF THE INAUGURATION OF THE CHIMOIO BRANCH CHIMOIO, OCTOBER 9, 2020 Mr President of the Republic of Mozambique, Excellency, Mr Minister for Economy and Finance, Excellency, Mr Secretary of State of the Province of Manica, Excellency, Madam Governor of manica province, Excellency, Honourable Members of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Distinguished Representatives of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations, Distinguished Guests, Ladies and gentlemen, Very good morning! I would like to greet, in particular, His Excellency Filipe Jacinto Nyusi, President of the Republic of Mozambique, and thank you for accepting, without reservation, the invitation we have made, despite your busy agenda. I take this opportunity to thank, in particular, our organizing team, which made no effort to ensure that this opening ceremony took place without any overlaps. I also address my words of appreciation to the contractor Soares da Costa and the entire technical team involved in the construction of the Chimoio branch. Ladies Gentlemen, the inauguration of this subsidiary represents an important milestone in the history of our institution and the national financial system because, as of today, all the provinces of our vast country now have the physical presence of the Bank of Mozambique. The Chimoio Branch building developed with the use of the offices of the former Banco Nacional Overseas and has a total paved area of 10,000 square meters, combining the standards of beauty, comfort and resilience to the effects of climate change, which have cyclically affected our country. I end my speech by reiterating my thanks to all those present at this ceremony, and with the conviction that we have taken significant steps towards fulfilling our mission of promoting the financial inclusion and valorization of metical, our currency. Thank you very much!

Title: Intervention at the Inauguration of the Moza Banco Agency in Majune
text: INTERVENTION OF HIS EXCELLENcy THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, Dr. ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA On the occasion of the INAUGURATION OF THE MOZABANCO AGENCY IN AAAJUNE LICHINGA, NOVEMBER 6, 2020 Mr Deputy Minister for Agriculture and Rural Development, Your Excellency, Mr Secretary of State of niassa Province, Excellency, Mr. Administrator of the District of Majune, Honourable Madam Administrator of the Bank of Mozambique, Honourable Chairman of the Board of Directors of Moza Banco, Distinguished Representatives of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations, Distinguished Guests, Very good morning! I offer my greetings to all present at this opening ceremony of moza's first agency Bank in the district of Majune, Niassa province, and I thank you, on behalf of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, the invitation that was formulated to us to participate in this event. Let me address our congratulations to Moza Banco, its employees, managers and members of the board of directors, represented by its President, Dr. Joao Figueiredo, for the initiative to open this agency, which represents the first at the level of the District of Majune, and the agency in the district of Chimbunila, inaugurated yesterday. It is with great pride that we witness the end of the suffering of the population of Majune, who were forced to travel long distances to gain access to a bank branch, being subject to various risks. This inauguration reflects the importance that the Bank of Mozambique gives financial inclusion, because we do not believe it is possible to develop a country with financial inequalities. I leave my appeal to the residents of this district to preserve this agency and deposit their savings in it, because only then will there be resources to pass on to those who have funding needs, as is the case with the agricultural campaign. Address a word of appreciation to the provincial and district government, and to community leaders for the support granted, without which it would not have been possible to materialize this project. Moza Banco's decision to deploy its agency in this district is part of the Government's "One District, One Bank" program that responds to the concern presented by economic agents and the population. We believe that the installation of Majune's agency will serve as an incentive for more credit institutions to have their representations at the level of this and other districts of the province, still devoid of financial services. We are certain that the start-up of this agency will bring greater scope and flexibility in the liquidation of financial transactions in Majune in particular and niassa province in general, thus contributing to the further development of economic activity and, above all, to the improvement of financial inclusion indicators at province level. I take this opportunity to call on economic actors and the general population of Majune District to use this Agency to cultivate savings habits, an essential element for making their investments in the future. I end my speech by reiterating our congratulations to Moza Banco and wishing for success. Thank you very much!

Termino a minha interveno reiterando as nossas felicitaes ao Moza Banco e desejando sucessos. Muito obrigado!

Title: Intervention at the Inauguration of the Metical Square in Beira City
text: INTERVENTION OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, Dr. ROG83RIO ZANDAMELA ON THE OCCASION OF THE INAUGURATION OF THE PRA82A DO METICALDA CIDADE DA BEIRA BEIRA, DECEMBER 9, 2020 Mr President of the Beira Municipal Council, Your Honourable Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Your Honourable Council members of beira city council, dear managers and technicians of the Bank of Mozambique and the Beira Municipal Council, Distinguished guests My ladies and gentlemen, very good morning! It is with great satisfaction that, on behalf of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, I greet all those present at this opening ceremony of the Metical Square of the city of Beira, the first in the country, as part of the project for the implementation of Metical squares in all provincial capitals. The act we have just witnessed is the result of a commitment officially signed on September 13, 2017, with the signing of the Memorandum of Understanding between the Bank of Mozambique and the Municipal Council of the city of Beira. At the time, we are committed to rehabilitating The Metical Square, ensuring the placement of a monument that dignifies our currency, the Metical, the assembly of rest benches for users and the placement of lampposts and lamps. Today, we joyfully witness the materialization of this commitment, which reflects the mutual trust and engagement of the two institutions. Let me therefore address a word of appreciation to the President of the Municipal Council of the city of Beira, Mr Daviz Simango, and to the delegation accompanying him for the collaboration made during the rehabilitation of The Metical Square. I would like to extend my gratitude to the managers and technicians of the Bank of Mozambique for the commitment and dedication to the work that culminates in this inauguration. I take the opportunity to also greet the contractor Soares da Costa Mo8dambique for having contributed to the rehabilitation of the Metical square of the city of Beira. Ladies and gentlemen, I am pleased to stress that we have successfully achieved the goal of giving greater beauty and dignity to the city of Beira, as well as to enhance our currency, the Metical, one of the most important symbols of our country's economic stability. Thus, we understand that the necessary conditions are created for the city dwellers of this beautiful city to enjoy this space, not only for leisure but also of great historical significance. I end my speech by thanking everyone for their presence, and i call on the citizens to take a stand of conservation and preservation of our heritage, so that it can also benefit future generations. Thank you very much!

Title: Intervention at the Inauguration of the Bank of Mozambique Branch in Beira City
text: SPEECH OF HIS EXCELLENCY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MOZAMBIQUE, Dr. ROGeRIO ZANDAMELA ON THE OCCASION OF THE INAUGURATION OF THE BRANCH OF BANCO DE MOcAMBIQUENA CIDADE DA BEIRA BEIRA, DECEMBER 10, 2020 Mr President of the Republic of Mozambique, Excellency, Madam Secretary of State of the Province of Sofala, Excellency, Mr Governor of the Province of Sofala, Your Excellency, Mr President of the Beira Municipal Council, Honourable Members of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique, Distinguished Representatives of Credit Institutions and Financial Corporations, Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen Good morning! It is with high honor and satisfaction that, on behalf of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, I greet everyone present at this opening ceremony of the new bank of Mozambique branch building in the city of Beira. Allow me to welcome his Excellency the President of the Republic of Mozambique, Filipe Jacinto Nyusi, who, even in the face of a very busy agenda, welcomed our invitation to participate in this ceremony. Address my special thanks to the authorities of the province of Sofala, namely His Excellency the Secretary of State, Stella Pinto Novo Zeca, His Excellency the Governor of the province, Lourenco Bulha, and the Honorable President of the Municipality of Beira, Daviz Simango, for the valuable collaboration for the materialization of this important infrastructure that we inaugurate today. I take this opportunity to thank the contractor Soares da Costa and all the technical team involved in the rehabilitation and construction of these buildings. I express my thanks to our organizing team and to everyone who was directly or indirectly involved in the preparation of this event. Ladies Gentlemen, With the inauguration of the Chimoio Branch, last October, we have completed our process of territorial expansion and since then all provincial capitals of our country have now had the physical presence of the Bank of Mozambique. The infrastructure we inaugurate today is part of the process of modernizing our services throughout the national territory, which aims to respond more comprehensively and effectively to the challenges facing our financial system. This property has a total area of 10,000 square meters and consists of two buildings, the first, the result of the rehabilitation of the facilities that, in the past, housed the National Overseas Bank and, later, the Commercial Bank of Mozambique, and the second a root construction. We believe that with these new buildings, we will give greater comfort and convenience to the workers and users of this branch. Still in the context of the modernization of our services, we are currently in the process of rehabilitation of the Branch of the Bank of Mozambique in the city of Nampula, whose inauguration is scheduled for next year. I end my speech by reiterating our thanks to all present, convinced that with these facilities we are better prepared to fulfil our mission of promoting the financial inclusion and appreciation of the Metical. Thank you very much!

Title: Intervention at the Inauguration of the Nampula Branch
text: INTERVENTION OF HIS EXCELLENCYROGeRIO ZANDAMELA, GOVERNOR OF BANCODE MOcAMBIQUE ON THE OCCASION OF THE INAUGURATION FROM THE NEW NAMPULA BRANCH BUILDING NAMPULA, 25 NOVEMBER 2021 Allow me, on behalf of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Mozambique and on my behalf, to express my deep thanks for your presence at this opening ceremony of the new bank of Mozambique branch building in the city of Nampula. I would like to greet and thank, in a special way, His Excellency Filipe Jacinto Nyusi, President of the Republic of Mozambique, for honouring us with his presence at this ceremony. My greetings and thanks extend to the authorities of the province of Nampula, represented by the Secretary of State, the Governor and the President of the Municipality Council of Nampula, for their prompt collaboration in the whole process of building this building, as well as in the preparation of this ceremony. I take this opportunity to thank, in particular, the team of the Bank of Mozambique who worked hard to make this opening ceremony a reality. I also address my words of appreciation to the contractor Anibal de Oliveira Cristina, Limitada and all the technical team involved in the construction of this building, for the commitment and professionalism shown. I also thank all the citizens of the city of Nampula, in particular those who live or work in the vicinity of this building, for the patience and tolerance to the inevitable noise pollution that characterizes the enterprises of this great that As is common knowledge, this work has been paralyzed for a long time, resulting from an exhausting dispute for the Bank of Mozambique, and it has even been very difficult to find support even in institutions that aim to protect the public good. In this sequence, the Bank of Mozambique has only recently resumed ownership of this Building that we are inaugurating today, thanks to the leadership and personal commitment of His Excellency the President of the Republic. Ladies Gentlemen The building we inaugurate today is an integral part of the process of modernization of infrastructure and expansion of the Bank of Mozambique by all provincial capitals, in order to improve the services we provide. The enormous economic potential that the province of Nampula presents, characterized by the constant transformation of infrastructure and improvement of the business environment, already required a strong presence of the Bank of Mozambique, in order to respond effectively and efficiently to the challenges posed by the growth of the volume of economic transactions. It is in this context that the building inaugurated now will contribute to consolidating the articulation with credit institutions and financial corporations, as well as with public institutions at the province level. In addition, this building will also contribute to put into circulation, in a timely manner and under more appropriate conditions, notes and coins of the Metical, in addition to being at the service of the economy as a whole, taking into account the complaints of users of the financial system and other requests that fall within our competencies. We believe that with these new facilities we will respond to the concerns of our workers and users of this branch, by providing greater comfort and convenience, increasing the productivity and quality of the services provided. Ladies Gentlemen This new branch of the Bank of Mozambique has a total area of 7,500 square meters and was built from scratch, with a structure in reinforced concrete. The branch consists of four floors, where are located, among others, areas of offices and public service, cafeteria, library and conference room, and a basement where the car park is located. In addition to the features already mentioned, this infrastructure will contribute to increase the architectural beauty of the city of Nampula. In closing, I reiterate my thanks to all those present at this ceremony, convinced that with these facilities we are better prepared to fulfill our mission of promoting the financial inclusion and appreciation of the Metical. Allow me to take this opportunity to, on behalf of the Bank of Mozambique, make a virtual gift to His Excellency the President of the Republic. It is an acrylic painting on canvas, executed by the artist Tsenane who represents the new building of the Branch of the Bank of Mozambique in Nampula, inserted in the rhythmic movement of the city, where early in the morning the streets fill with people going to various places in search of their to-do. In the painting, stand out the macuas women with their traditional capulanas of bright colors dancing tufo, to celebrate the new building of the Bank of Mozambique. Thank you very much!
